description: Change a contact: pass contact_id and at least one of name, email, phone, address, external_id and metadata; null clears phone, address or external_id. A contact cannot be moved to another customer. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

contact_id.description: The contact: its id, as list_contacts shows it.

external_id.description: Your own id for the contact; null clears it.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

phone.description: The contact phone number; null clears it.

name: update_contact
